name: manual_254212
claim: Agent capabilities fail independently: a CLI can be unreliable for unattended headless tool use and still be a strong analysis and review voice, so scope a degraded agent to the role it can do rather than benching it entirely.

decisions.notes: Board records 1360 to 1364 on 2026-08-14 established that AntiGravity 1.1.13 is authenticated but auto-denies unexpected shell command requests in headless print mode, making it untrustworthy for unattended tool-using automation. The same day it produced a substantive plan review and caught a gap - no commit-stat preflight before mutating the branch - that neither the codex reviewer nor a full dual-voice autoplan pipeline had found. Proposed disposition is standing review voice on plan-level gates, invoked in plan mode against parent-supplied artifacts, never a headless implementation seat.
